name: utopia-hooks-migrate-bloc
description: 👾 Migrate Flutter BLoC/Cubit codebases to utopia_hooks. Two-phase migration (global states first, then screens) with per-commit granularity, dart analyze baseline (Dart MCP preferred), screen-local vs global Cubit classification, and universal pattern-family handling (persistent-state, stream-source, reactive-input, lifecycle). Includes the /utopia-hooks-migrate-bloc:migrate orchestrator coordinating five sub-agents: migrate-inventory, migrate-foundation, migrate-global-state, migrate-screen, and migrate-review. Recommended companion: utopia-hooks plugin.
